more_info.overview: Methyl cellulose is used as an emulsifier in food. Its technological role is to help oil and water remain mixed.
more_info.uses: EU permissions include table-top sweeteners in powder form, table-top sweeteners in tablets. These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
more_info.side_effects:
Assessed food uses raised no concern.
High-dose animal studies found no reproductive or developmental harm.
